title: build_email_from_create generates an email id via next_id() that create_object always overwrites
description: email.rs:655-656: the Email is constructed with next_id() as its id field. create_object is then called (line 421), and the backend assigns the real id, returning (assigned_id, created_object). The id generated in build_email_from_create is thrown away. Callers reading the code see an Email being built with a real-looking id, but it is discarded. Fix: build the Email with a sentinel value (Id::from('placeholder') like mailbox.rs:685 and identity.rs:163 do) rather than consuming a counter value. The id should come from create_object, not from the handler.
